facts.statement: Fushanosaurus is a sauropod dinosaur genus named after the Fushan Museum in China where its fossils are stored.
facts.quote: Fushanosaurus (; meaning "Fushan lizard", after the Fushan Museum where its remains are stored) is a genus of sauropod dinosaur from the Shishugou Formation from Xinjiang Province in China.

facts.statement: The only known species of Fushanosaurus is Fushanosaurus qitaiensis.
facts.quote: The type and only species is Fushanosaurus qitaiensis ().

facts.statement: The entire genus is known only from a single fossil: a complete right femur labeled FH000101.
facts.quote: It is solely known from the holotype specimen FH000101, a complete right femur.

facts.statement: The holotype femur of Fushanosaurus qitaiensis measures 180 centimeters in length.
facts.quote: The holotype femur of F. qitaiensis is 180 cm long.

facts.statement: Based on comparisons with other Asian sauropods, Fushanosaurus was estimated to be approximately 30 meters long, making it one of the longest known dinosaurs.
facts.quote: By comparison to two other giant sauropods from Asia, Ruyangosaurus and Daxiatitan, Fushanosaurus was estimated to have been approximately 30 m long, which would then make it one of the longest known dinosaurs.

facts.statement: Although originally classified as a titanosauriform, Fushanosaurus may actually belong to the mamenchisaurid group.
facts.quote: Fushanosaurus was originally described as a titanosauriform, but the features initially believed to indicate titanosauriform affinities are actually more widespread among sauropods, and Fushanosaurus may be a mamenchisaurid, the only group of sauropods definitely known to be present in the Shishugou Formation.

facts.statement: Fushanosaurus is classified within the parent group Titanosauriformes.
Fushanosaurus belongs to the dinosaur class Saurischia.
Fushanosaurus lived during the Oxfordian stage of the Late Jurassic, between 161.5 and 154.8 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Oxfordian to Oxfordian (161.5 to 154.8 million years ago)
